title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1969-02-27

ai_review.summary: Rare 1969 sound‑board tape that reviewers love for its existence, though many complain about site access and give no musical detail.
ai_review.review: The recording is a 1969 Grateful Dead show captured from the sound board (as implied by the filename), and several fans applaud its historic value. However, the reviews contain little discussion of performance or audio fidelity; instead they focus on frustrations with downloading the tape and unrelated personal opinions, resulting in a mixed overall impression.

ai_rating.rationale: Only a few reviewers comment positively on the show’s rarity, while several give zero‑star ratings for site access issues and provide no concrete musical or technical assessment, leading to an average rating with moderate confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No reviewer mentions sound clarity, mix balance, or other audio characteristics.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviews do not describe the setlist or performance flow; comments are limited to availability and personal grievances.
